meta.description: University of Delhi — India's premier central university.

description: India's premier central university with 90+ colleges. Offers B.A., B.Sc., B.Com, B.Tech, B.E., B.A. (Hons), M.A., M.Sc., M.Com, M.Tech, MBA, and Ph.D. programs. Follows CBCS with 7-point/10-point grading (O/A+/A/B+/B/C/F). Semester system. Recently adopted NEP 2020 Four Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUP).

academic_calendar.details: Odd semester: Jul-Dec, Even semester: Jan-Jun. End semester exams in Dec and May respectively.
